description:
src/ir_interp/backend.rs:755-788 (prepared_dispatch_keys) allocates every binary prepared key on the process heap (fz_alloc_bitstring_const, a real copy) before the first test runs, on every call. A function whose hot clause never reaches its map pattern still pays for every key it could have read.

Change: the prepared vector holds lazily filled cells, filled at dispatch_const_key_value (dispatch_exec.rs ~715-723) and memoized per run so a key reached on two paths sees one word.

Signal: map_binary_keys and 00553_match_map_nonatom_keys on three doors; a fixture whose map clause is not reached pins zero bitstring allocations through Process.heap_alloc_stats().
title: Prepared dispatch keys materialize on first read
